Closing as completed — all three tracked items landed in #3315 (merged):

- [x] **engine-owned vs admin-writable distinction** — expressed via `userActions` on the `system`/`append-only` writable set (RBAC link tables, `sys_user_preference`, `sys_approval_delegation`, and the messaging config grids), with `resolveCrudAffordances` as the single write-policy contract. No new enum value (avoids the fully-editable fallthrough on deployed clients).
- [x] **engine-level write guard** — `assertEngineOwnedWriteAllowed` (plugin-security) fail-closes user-context generic writes to engine-owned objects, `isSystem`/context-less bypass; `reconcileManagedApiMethods` generalized to every managed bucket; `/me/permissions` clamp generalized.
- [x] **`apiMethods` contradictions** — declared the true policy on each object (`['get','list']` on the engine-owned set, `userActions` on the writable set; `sys_import_job` route elevated to `isSystem`).

`writeVia` for third-party-managed objects stays out of scope (deferred, #1878) as noted.

A latent drift the audit surfaced adjacent to this — the hand-maintained `BETTER_AUTH_MANAGED_OBJECTS` deny-list in the default permission sets (17 listed vs 22 schemas) — is tracked separately in #3325 and fixed in #3326, since it's a distinct ADR-0092 registry-driven concern rather than part of this taxonomy split.
